_docs: Per-component allowlist for mcp-scan (snyk-agent-scan) warnings. Maps a skill path (relative to repo root, e.g. 'skills/<name>') to the warning codes that are acceptable for that skill and the external domains it legitimately references. Each entry MUST include a 'reason' justifying why the finding is a false positive or by-design behavior. If a skill introduces a new external domain not listed under 'domains', the allowlist entry will NOT suppress the finding and the check fails (domain census). Placeholder domains (example.com, myapp.com, localhost, etc.) are excluded from validation. Start empty; add entries only after triaging a real finding. Schema mirrors the developer-kit reference: 'components' is a list of { path, allow: [codes], domains: [hosts], reason }.
